item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the 2% skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"Three material validation and failure-policy decisions remain unresolved.","questions":[{"decision_key":"release_acceptance_proof","label":"Acceptance proof","context":"The plan needs a clear standard for declaring the streamlined product ready.","question":"What proof is required before acceptance?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Existing checks plus human validation of all six tabs and critical failure recovery."},{"number":2,"text":"Existing automated checks plus happy-path validation only."},{"number":3,"text":"Manual review of the six tabs without formal recovery tests."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":96},{"decision_key":"leased_run_failure_policy","label":"Lease failures","context":"Provider crashes and expired atomic leases can cause duplicate execution or lost work.","question":"How should failed leased runs recover?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Retry with idempotency keys, then stop after a bounded limit for manual review."},{"number":2,"text":"Retry indefinitely until a provider succeeds."},{"number":3,"text":"Fail immediately and require manual restart."},{"number":4,"text":"Attempt exactly-once execution with no duplicate tolerance."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":94},{"decision_key":"approval_binding_scope","label":"Approval scope","context":"Approval-gated stages need an auditable rule for what an approval authorizes.","question":"What should each approval bind to?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"The immutable stage revision, inputs, outputs, and validation evidence; any change invalidates approval."},{"number":2,"text":"The stage revision only; changed inputs or outputs retain approval."},{"number":3,"text":"The whole workflow version with one shared approval."},{"number":4,"text":"The conversation request without artifact-level binding."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":91}]}
